dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: What's in this jar? I found it in the corner when cleaning your apartment.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: It's a jar containing my written wishes on paper slips. Whenever I lắc lọ, I pick one piece of paper and try to fulfill it.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: lắc lọ to choose wishes? I find this a bit silly. We Russians usually believe in fate rather than điều ước.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: But sometimes lắc lọ helps us make decisions when we're hesitant. thử it, you might enjoy it.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Alright, I'll thử lắc lọ once. If I draw a paper saying "play chess with Mira," do you dare to play a game?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Of course! But what if the paper says "kiss the person you're thinking about"? Would you dare to do it?
